{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
# Only include completed orders from LOYAL customers
filtered_df = df[
    (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) &
    (df['status'] == 'completed') &
    (df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = filtered_df['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f"Number of completed LOYAL orders after filtering: {len(filtered_df)}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
